project.name: TinyCLIP
project.description: PyTorch implementation of TinyCLIP: CLIP distillation via affinity mimicking and weight inheritance.

runtime.build_command: python -m compileall -q src my_code inference.py measure_throughput.py

PYTHONPATH.purpose: Makes src/training and src/open_clip importable during training/evaluation.

HF_TOKEN.purpose: Hugging Face token used only by my_code/test/dataset.py for gated datasets.

functional_scenarios.name: library_smoke_check
functional_scenarios.description: Verify the version module is readable and the harness environment is consistent.
steps: Confirm it prints the TinyCLIP version and exits zero
functional_scenarios.expected_outcome: Version is printed without importing PyTorch.

functional_scenarios.name: architecture_boundary_check
functional_scenarios.description: Verify package imports respect the open_clip/training/my_code layer boundaries.
functional_scenarios.expected_outcome: Dependency linter passes and quality linter reports only known warnings.

assumptions: Project is a Python library with training/evaluation CLI entry points.
No external services are required for core model operations.
Training and evaluation require NVIDIA GPUs and dataset paths supplied by the user.
todos: Set HF_TOKEN only when using my_code/test/dataset.py with gated datasets.
Add tests under tests/ before enabling make test in CI.
